title: Ma Chao Comes Over; Liu Zhang Gives Up Yi Province
summary: Ma Chao and Zhang Fei fight at Jiameng from midday until torches are lit and neither can put the other down. Then Li Hui talks Ma Chao into changing sides — he has nowhere else to go, and Zhang Lu is already trying to have him killed.
Ma Chao rides to Chengdu's walls and calls up, and Liu Zhang surrenders the next day rather than see the city stormed. Liu Bei has a province at last, twenty-nine years after the peach garden.
history: Historical: Ma Chao's defection really did end the siege without a fight, because Liu Zhang's nerve broke at the sight of him.
